scripts.build: vite build && esbuild server/index.ts --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/server.js && npm run sync-dist
scripts.sync-dist: mkdir -p app/bundle/assets app/bundle/images && cp package.json app/bundle/package.json && cp package-lock.json app/bundle/package-lock.json && cp dist/index.html app/bundle/index.html && cp dist/assets/app.js app/bundle/assets/app.js && cp dist/server.js app/bundle/server.js && cp dist/images/*.svg app/bundle/images/
